stationContext: UNCONFIRMED PUBLICLY. The code 'DEPO-501' / 'Depo 501' could not be found in any official KCIC publication or reputable news source (exact-term web searches returned no results); it appears to be an internal location code provided by the project team (it also appears without an address in this repo's seed data and DATA_READINESS.md). The most likely referent is Depo Tegalluar, the only rolling-stock maintenance depot on the Whoosh Jakarta-Bandung high-speed line: KCIC's official press release 'Mengenal Depo Tegalluar, Rumah Kereta Api Cepat Jakarta-Bandung' (26 Sep 2022, https://kcic.co.id/kcic-siaran-pers/mengenal-depo-tegalluar-rumah-kereta-api-cepat-jakarta-bandung/) describes it as the maintenance home of the KCIC400AF trainsets with seven technical areas (Dynamic Monitor Shed, Stabling Zone with 14 tracks, Temporary Repair & Loading Wheel-Set, Train Washing, Dynamic Debugging Zone, Rescue Facility, Joint Workshop). Kompas (28 Sep 2022, https://bandung.kompas.com/read/2022/09/28/195236578/mengintip-depo-tegalluar-tempat-perawatan-kereta-api-cepat-jakarta-bandung) places the depot in Desa Tegalluar, Kecamatan Bojongsoang, Kabupaten Bandung, Jawa Barat. Wikipedia's 'High-speed rail in Indonesia' article likewise lists the line's single depot at Tegalluar. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: the depot (Desa Tegalluar, Bojongsoang) is NOT the same site as the passenger station Stasiun Tegalluar (Cibiru Hilir, Cileunyi); most lodging articles reference the station, so distances in those articles are station-relative and cannot be used as distances to the depot. CREW ACCOMMODATION: no fetched official KCIC source explicitly states that KCIC operates crew lodging at the depot. KCIC official social-media posts surfaced in search snippets mention a depot area of ~58 Ha including 'Gedung OCC' and 'Gedung tempat istirahat' (rest building), but these snippets were not retrievable as full official pages, so this remains an unverified lead, NOT a confirmed KCIC crew accommodation. All properties below are public lodging in eastern Bandung (Gedebage/Cinambo/Panyileukan/Buahbatu corridor along Jl. Soekarno-Hatta) near the Tegalluar station/depot general area; proximity to the depot itself is unconfirmed.
